_comment: This repo's CLI and verbs (PLAN-architecture.md §12.1); it keeps no store. `list` and `writers` are the read verbs: `run`/`all`/`one`/`fixtures` run checks (repro among them), so they are not declared here; `stores` reads but walks the whole workspace, which repro would do twice pre-commit, so it is not declared either; `practices` runs the checks its rows name across the whole workspace (and `--import`/`--lower` write gates.json and the baseline), so it is not a read verb.
